senses.definition: An endangered breed of sheep indigenous to the Asturias province of Northern Spain.
A subtle plan (usually villainous) that cannot be foiled, such that attempts to defeat it actually further its creator's goals.
senses.example: It strikes me, as it no doubt has struck many of you, that this strategy is cynical. What may not have struck you is how cynical, how much of a Xanatos Gambit, this game their play

senses.definition: A natural gum, produced by the fermentation of sugars by the bacterium Xanthomonas campestris; used as a food additive.

Any of a group of brilliant fluorescent yellow to pink to bluish red dyes characterized by the presence of the xanthene nucleus, known sometimes in colorless as well as colored forms, and used chiefly in dyeing textile fibers, in coloring paper, in producing fluorescent effects, and as organic pigments.
any of a class of organic sulphur-containing acids of general formula ROCS₂H

A crystallizable flavoprotein enzyme containing iron and molybdenum that promotes the oxidation especially of hypoxanthine and xanthine to uric acid and of many aldehydes to carboxylic acids and that is obtained usually from milk or liver.
An acid, CS₂C₂H₅OH, formed from the decomposition of potassic xanthogenate.

An uncommon, severe form of chronic pyelonephritis characterized by granulomatous inflammation, abscess formation, and extensive renal parenchymal destruction, often mimicking renal cell carcinoma or other inflammatory renal diseases.
A non-crystallizable yellow substance derived from proteins upon treatment with nitric acid.
The compound 4,8-dihydroxyquinoline-2-carboxylic acid that is excreted by animals that are deficient in pyridoxine after ingestion of tryptophan.
A combination of xanthinol and niacin (nicotinic acid), used as a vasodilator.
An Italian chicken soup with parmesan dumplings.
